text:
Elena (Product): Hey team — launching preview of the Airgap Repair Toolkit (ART) for Private / on‑prem customers today. ART is a compact ops bundle to help with remote diagnostics, signed repair images, and faster recovery in air‑gapped environments. Preview is pilot-only. Docs + installer: https://intranet.redwood/airgap-art-preview :tada:
Raj (Infra): Quick notes — ART uses an agentless collector and a signed artifact flow. For support we need customers to commit to a maintenance window. Proposing a 2hr weekly window as default, configurable per customer.
Maya (Security): Clarification: telemetry in preview is limited to anonymized repair hashes and success/failure metrics; no customer payloads leave the cluster. We added a KMS-backed signing flow and an attestation bundle for audits. Compliance writeup: https://intranet.redwood/compliance/art-telemetry :lock:
Jordan (CS): I'll start outreach to current Private customers who expressed interest. Need a one‑pager for pilots with rollback instructions and SLA expectations.
Elena (Product): One‑pager draft here: https://docs.redwood/airgap-art/pilot-onboarding — please review by EOD. Also: policy change (preview -> GA): "mandatory patch window" for covered Private support contracts. Intention is to ensure we can deliver proactive fixes. We'll give 30 days notice before enforcement. :warning:
Raj (Infra): Ops rollout plan (snippet):
```
# Example maintenance window crons (UTC)
# Monday 02:00-04:00
0 2 * * 1
# Saturday 00:00-02:00
0 0 * * 6
```
Staged rollout: canary -> 25% -> 100% across customer pools with health checks and automatic rollback.
Maya (Security): We'll publish SOC-relevant artifacts for each release: signed SBOM, attestations, and the repair-image hash list. Customers who require no telemetry can request a carveout via support ticket; legal signoff required.
Jordan (CS): Draft message for customers: "We recommend scheduling a weekly 2–3 hour maintenance window to enable ART and faster recoveries. Enrollment may be required for proactive patching and support. Contact your CSM to opt in or request carveouts." I can tailor per customer.
Elena (Product): Pilot timeline: week 0 — invite 5 pilot customers; weeks 1–3 — remote runs + diagnostics; week 4 — consolidate feedback and publish GA readiness checklist.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: ART-preview v0.1 -> infra-staging at 2051235600
Maya (Security): Action item: add ART preview to the compliance tracker and loop in Legal for any TOS updates.
Jordan (CS): +1. I'll own customer comms and the internal FAQ.
Elena (Product): If you object to the mandatory patch window policy, reply here before EOD Friday. If no objections, we'll lock the schedule and start pilot onboarding next week. Thanks all. :spiral_calendar:
